blockers.description: First-key initialization blocks indefinitely before its bounded retry loop and globally serializes unrelated stores.
blockers.workaround: Implement deadline-aware nonblocking per-authority locking and typed timeout.

blockers.description: Pending/sidecar inventory uses unstable filesystem order with lexical/mixed-namespace cursors and is not truly call-bounded.
blockers.workaround: Implement a backend-stable bounded inventory/cursor contract with explicit name/read/action counters.

blockers.description: Reconciliation apply double-charges orphan sidecars and lets exact sidecar lifecycle conflicts abort later work.
blockers.workaround: Normalize one action stream, charge each attempted action once, and isolate exact conflicts per finding.

decisions.decision: Trust the local store owner not to deliberately destroy or rebind all live authority objects.
decisions.rationale: Portable per-key coordination cannot be immutable against the same principal deleting every authority object without external coordination or global serialization.

decisions.decision: Limit Windows local-store coordination to one OS user and one interactive/service session for this milestone.
decisions.rationale: Preserves ordinary Windows compatibility without claiming an unvalidated cross-principal authority and ACL model.

decisions.decision: Continue independent review/fix cycles beyond the default cap.
decisions.rationale: Repeated deterministic reviews found blockers after green suites and all-fixed reports.
